claims.source_quote_ar: على لفظ التخصيص والإقبال عليهما بالخطاب
claims.claim_ar: الآية توظف التعريف في كلمة «الْحَقُّ» ثم التنكير في «مَوْعِظَةٌ وَذِكْرَىٰ»، فيعطي ذلك تمييزاً للحقّ على أنه المقصود الخاصّ وتعميماً للنفع في الموعظة والذكرى.
claims.claim_en: The verse uses definiteness in 'al-haqq' and indefiniteness in 'maw'iza and dhikra', producing a rhetorical contrast: the Truth is presented as the particular, central reality while admonition and reminder are presented as general benefits.
claims.needs_review_reason: Interpretation maps the definite/indefinite pattern in the verse to the classical device 'تعريف وتنكير'; confirmation from additional tafsir/balagha sources (al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, etc.) would strengthen confidence.

claims.claim_ar: تعبير «نُثَبِّتُ بِهِ فُؤَادَكَ» فيه استعارة/مجاز: «الفؤاد» مجازيّة تدلّ على الإيمان واليقين، و«تثبيت الفؤاد» بمعنى تثبيت القلب على الإيمان واقتداره.
claims.claim_en: The phrase 'we strengthen/establish thereby your heart' is metaphorical: 'heart' (fu'ad) is used figuratively for faith/certitude, and 'to establish the heart' means to strengthen belief and conviction.
claims.needs_review_reason: Supported by a classical discussion of metaphor (مجاز) in the provided source; cross-checking with additional balagha commentaries would be beneficial but the metaphoric reading is well-established.

warnings: Provided source_chunks are from al-Kashshaf (Zamakhshari) only. Requested author set included al-Jurjani, al-Sakkaki, al-Baqillani, al-Suyuti, and tafsir-balagha; corresponding chunks were not supplied, so claims rely on the available chunk(s).
Some device assignments (e.g., tarif_tankir) are interpretive and would benefit from corroboration in additional classical balagha/tafsir sources.
